line: While this command has no origin, if the person runs `work request`, then `work` shall refuse the command and name an origin.

line: While a request is `open` and a request line proposed in the request is `accepted` and no request line blocks the request, when the person runs `work turn` on the request, `work` shall post a comment and keep the side of the request.
